summary: Certified a fork for actual exercise under a supplied power profile, with regress and circle witnesses, and one exercise on which the same events are instruments or secondary causes depending on the profile. Rejected before certification: defining borrowed as having a source or finite grounding, which would make the source follow by definition; defining borrowed as having an actual lender, which erases secondary causes and makes the moved-mover reading trivially true; letting an empty record lend, which counts a power as borrowed from nobody; letting a merely live unexercised record lend at the actual scenario. Rejected as overreach: treating retained power as underived, since it says nothing of how the power was got; treating a self-exercising source as explaining its exercise, since a finite source with essential power has an exercise that does not occur at every allowed scenario. The moved-mover reading is refuted on one fixed model, not as a claim about real agents, and is not identified with the attributed statement. Actual productive exercise, which profile holds of real agents, adequacy and motion-to-existence remain OPEN; rivals rejecting Supply or profiles are not refuted. No source claim was added. Findings in docs/notes/borrowed-exercise-741.md. No root premise change. Vocabulary audit for #1659 and #1652 at main 91bcc8dbaef83166c09fbd30e09586764438e191: preserved all five capacity/exercise sense identities; linked actual transmission to the existing Profile field with explicit primitive meaning, and corrected endpoint existence to require Coherent. Reused the borrowed-power profile for exercise, exercised, capacity and power lexicon tracing. Capacity remains a supplied parameter without a common named declaration: the event/scenario and bearer/world consumers require an explicit interpretation map, not an alias to Borrowed or a stronger IntendedProfile. Exact direct consumer inventory, claim/type sweep, rejected substitutions and next adapter test persist in docs/power-existence-scope-boundary.md under Capacity and exercise vocabulary audit. No theorem, source attribution, philosophical defeat or root discharge is added. No substantive objection to the distinctions was identified; the existing source-free rival remains unresolved. Local Lean dependencies and build seed are absent, so generated formal status and affected binding are deferred to coordinator integration.
